settings.heading: A closer look at every component.
settings.lede: Four actives, and the amount of each in every MOVO Boost pouch. Tap any component to see how it works in the body.

settings.heading: Electrolytes and supporting ingredients
settings.body: Doses shown are per pouch and are identical in Mint and Citrus.

settings.label: Electrolyte
settings.name: Sodium
settings.body: The electrolyte you lose most in sweat. Sodium keeps fluid where your muscles need it and helps nerves fire on time.

settings.label: Electrolyte
settings.name: Potassium
settings.body: Sodium’s partner. Potassium works inside your cells to keep muscles contracting and relaxing smoothly.

settings.label: Electrolyte
settings.name: Magnesium
settings.body: The relaxation mineral. Magnesium helps muscles release after they contract and supports the energy systems that keep you going.

settings.label: Amino acid
settings.name: L-Taurine
settings.body: An amino acid concentrated in your muscles. Taurine supports muscle function, hydration at the cellular level, and endurance.

settings.heading: Other ingredients
settings.body: Alongside the four actives, each pouch contains microcrystalline cellulose (MCC) as the carrier, xylitol and menthol for taste, and natural flavors. No sugar, no caffeine, no nicotine.
